notes.title: FULL VERSION
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

The Desktop Mars is finally ready to leave the Early Access stage.

The game has been improved and upgraded with new buildings to create more amazing Mars colonies.

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]

Optimization to reduce PC usage.

Many new buildings.

The new mining drone system.

Improved menu.

Fixed minor bugs.

The new DUST STORMS system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41898333/13f647d98da7185ac4debd258f3e83478ab21e8a.jpg[/img]

[h2]One of the biggest problems on Mars is the dust. We had to add this part to the game.[/h2]

The dust in game will reduce the productivity of the dirty building. You will have to clean the building to keep productivity at a high level. The cleaning is on a single button. You don't have to click and click on the dirty building.

The new DUST STORM can also fully destroy some of the buildings.  


----------------------------------------------------------------------------


[h2]I would like to thank everyone for their support, interesting ideas and constructive feedback. Thanks to you, this game is much better. Thank you![/h2]

Please let me know with any problems. I will fix it ASAP! :D

[h2]Best Regards,[/h2]
3DM Greg

tags.feature: The game has been improved and upgraded with new buildings to create more amazing Mars colonies.

notes.title: DESKTOP MARS ENTERS EARLY ACCESS
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Everyone[/h1]

We are pleased, after many months of hard work, to present you a new DESKTOP MARS game displayed as a Windows10 / 11 wallpaper.

[b]Are you bored with normal wallpapers? Change it to the interactive game DESKTOP MARS where your goal will be to expand the base and increase the population of your colony.[/b]

We hope you will like building a colony on Mars in the style of Minecraft / Voxel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41898333/fec673b98eb4c166e14672789bccb1f6f1698456.jpg[/img]

[b]DESKTOP MARS is in the Early Access phase but is fully playable.[/b]
I am still working on this game, so there will be more content soon.

I am also working on the balance of the game and what it costs and what it gives. Probably these values ​​will change soon.

At the exit of Early Access, I plan to add something special that will change the gameplay a bit. We are working on it right now.

The game will also have more languages. Write what language you want.

If you experience any problems please report them in the "Discussions" panel on Steam. You can also feel free to write to me. I will write back as soon as possible.

[h2]Remember! This game requires WINDOWS 10/11 with all visual settings turned on. Read the "Discussion" panel for more information.[/h2]

[h1]Enjoy! : D[/h1]

[h2]All ideas and comments are welcome. ;)[/h2]

[b]Best Regards,[/b]
3DM Greg
